notes: Use structures and mainlineRoads once. Per-point y controls deck height. The compatibility height field is only the way maximum.
CarrierRoads retain original shared nodes for topological and elevation continuity. The driving world owns the southbound and opposing roadway meshes.

Use northboundAlignment to move the existing opposing surface, traffic and outer edge to the true northbound alignment. Guardrail fromS/toS are always southbound stations. Side is relative to the named carriageway travel direction.
The two separate mapped one-lane Route 117 bridge branches are in structures. OSM contains no explicit motorcycle-only designation on either branch.

source.name: © OpenStreetMap contributors
source.coordinateSystem: Local east x, south z, meters. Same projection as route.json.

notes: OSM supplies horizontal centerlines, shared nodes, direction, and relative layer tags. Absolute heights, deck widths and thicknesses, shoulder widths and supports are prototype dimensions.
The commuter bridge uses the existing insideEndpoints profile, with ground at southbound s705.413 and s2476.504, and a 7 m deck across the central interchange.
Precomputed upper ramps pass above the commuter bridge. Both expressway mainlines pass below the commuter bridge at the mapped central planar crossings.
Eight directed movements join the real bridge and mainline through shared OSM nodes. Actual public approaches continue to Ziqiang South Road in the north and Ciyun Road in the south.
The interchange is modeled at local game scale. Validate access, structures and exact dimensions against a current survey for non-game use.
